p.title: v59.94 an official release stops being upcoming once its real release time has passed
p.symptom: The 오늘 화면 '앞으로' list showed last night's FOMC decision (and the previous evening's CPI) as a coming event on the morning read: a FOMC decision dated 2026-12-09 was still upcoming at 09:30 KST on 12-10, and CPI on 12-10 was still upcoming at 09:30 KST on 12-11.
p.root_cause: scheduleFacts in the market-day ledger gave every official release the fixed clock 13:30 UTC and kept it upcoming until 12 hours after that, ignoring the per-release clock (08:30 ET for CPI/jobs/PCE, 14:00 ET for FOMC) that releaseAtMs already provides.
p.fix: scheduleFacts reads the release time from releaseAtMs (13:30 UTC only as a fallback for an id without a known clock) and lists a release only while that time is still in the future; the 12-hour grace is removed.
p.violated_rule: A past event is not shown as coming.
p.prevention: ci-esm-core-unit-check builds the ledger at three instants around a FOMC decision and a CPI release and asserts which are upcoming; the assertions fail on the old fixed clock.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-esm-core-unit-check.mjs and node scripts/ci-metric-consistency-check.mjs exit 0; the new v59.94 case failed before the fix.

changelog: **Lead ({P}):** The market-day ledger lists an official release (CPI, jobs, PCE, FOMC) as upcoming only until its own release time, so the morning read no longer shows last night's decision as a coming event.
note: v59.94: released official events leave the upcoming list at their real release time
